title: game/world-options.json
description: The terrain options of a new world (Q02, D-game-37): the sliders of the New game page, each over a few of game/world.json's generator values with today's value as its default. Loaded by TerrainOptionData (Vocaterra.Game.Core); TerrainOptionValidator checks the grids, the targets and that world.json's own checks accept the numbers at every stop.

generated_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (hand-authored).

options.description: The sliders, in the order the New game page shows them.

id.description: The option's id, as --terrain <id>=<value> and the save name it.

label.description: The English label of the slider.

hint.description: A line of English that says what the option does.

unit.description: The unit shown after the value (%); not shown when labels names every stop.

step.description: The distance between two stops; it reaches max from min.

default.description: The value that leaves the world as game/world.json describes it; a stop of the grid.

labels.description: An English name for each stop from the lowest, or none to show the value.

effects.description: What the option changes, in the order it is applied.

target.description: The generator value, a path in game/world.json; the list is the code's (TerrainTarget).

mode.description: scale: the target times the value as a percent (default 100); scaleInverse: the target divided by it (default 100); offset: the value added (default 0); set: the target replaced by the value (default is the file's own).
